# axonops_cassandra_scheduled_repair (Resource)

Manages Cassandra scheduled repair configuration for a cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the Cassandra cluster.
- `schedule_expr` (String) Cron expression for the repair schedule (e.g. '0 * * 1 *' for monthly at midnight).
- `tag` (String) A unique tag to identify this scheduled repair. Used for matching during updates and deletes.

### Optional

- `blacklisted_tables` (List of String) List of tables to exclude from repair.
- `incremental` (Boolean) Whether to use incremental repair. Default: false
- `job_threads` (Number) Number of job threads. Default: 1
- `keyspace` (String) The keyspace to repair. Empty string means all keyspaces.
- `nodes` (List of String) List of specific nodes to repair. Empty means all nodes.
- `optimise_streams` (Boolean) Whether to optimise repair streams. Default: false
- `parallelism` (String) Repair parallelism mode. Valid values: Parallel, Sequential, DC-Aware. Default: Parallel
- `paxos_only` (Boolean) Whether to only run Paxos repair. Default: false
- `primary_range` (Boolean) Whether to use primary range repair. Default: false
- `segmented` (Boolean) Whether to use segmented repair. Default: false
- `segments_per_node` (Number) Number of segments per node. Default: 1
- `skip_paxos` (Boolean) Whether to skip Paxos repair. Default: false
- `specific_data_centers` (List of String) List of specific data centers to repair. Empty means all data centers.
- `tables` (List of String) List of tables to repair. Empty means all tables.

### Read-Only

- `repair_id` (String) The ID of the scheduled repair assigned by AxonOps.
